dependency.fallback: queue_front._records / _new_life on market_core inputs (replicated, parity-checked), settlement-only test with upd(f) for upd(f-1): the v2 straddle rule (contract section 5 item 2); candidates = v2 front_identified only

identity.reading: shares and counts only; a candidate link with its grade, never the identified creator; no verdict on maker intent

null.design: 500 circular shifts of each market-side's creation-event schedule (all types together); states fixed
null.offsets: Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([20261123, day, mid, side]))).integers(0, K) per market-side
null.p: (1 + #{null >= / <= obs}) / 501; ties within 1e-12 relative; NaN replicates on both sides

rules.d1000: every state read at t - 1000 ms (outcome window unchanged)
rules.improve: rows with anchor (D0) spread >= 2 only; spread contrast 3+ vs 2
rules.market_rr: within-market Mantel-Haenszel over the market's strata (crude beside)
rules.strata: market x side x time-left bin; time-left contrast: market x side
rules.verdict: take_logic: insufficient_support (< 5 supported markets or < 30 informative event-seconds) | supported (RR > 1, p_hi <= 0.05, >= 2/3 of supported markets RR > 1) | supported_lower (mirror: RR < 1, p_lo, RR < 1) | not_supported (take_logic's inconsistent folded in, predicate saved); timing_sensitive when the D1000 verdict differs

wording.days: four consumed days: point estimates, no intervals (G = 4 < 5)
wording.occupied: adding size at an occupied price is not a fresh creation; its absence is never "no posting"
wording.opportunity: an observed market opportunity, not an identified maker decision time
wording.p: a circular-shift tail fraction (timing alignment under fixed state paths), not independent-day confidence
